title: Add core22 to edubuntu snaps in noble
description:
Currently image builds for edubuntu are failing in noble. https://launchpadlibrarian.net/858099179/buildlog_ubuntu_noble_arm64_raspi_edubuntu-preinstalled_BUILDING.txt.gz

Error: Error preparing image: prerequisites need to be added explicitly: cannot use snap "gnome-42-2204": base "core22" is missing
Build failed
commit_message: Add core22 to edubuntu snaps in noble
diff:
diff --git a/edubuntu-pi-arm64.yaml b/edubuntu-pi-arm64.yaml
index 462fbe2..124f09a 100644
--- a/edubuntu-pi-arm64.yaml
+++ b/edubuntu-pi-arm64.yaml
@@ -44,6 +44,7 @@ customization:
   extra-snaps:
     - name: snapd
     - name: bare
+    - name: core22
     - name: gnome-42-2204
       channel: stable/ubuntu-24.04
     - name: gtk-common-themes
